name: Sailboat Retrospective
use_case: A visual retrospective built on a boat metaphor: wind pushing the team forward, anchors slowing it down, rocks ahead as risks, and an island as the shared goal. Best used when a team has grown tired of list-based retrospectives and stopped contributing, or when the discussion needs to hold goals, momentum, drag and upcoming risk in one picture rather than treating them as separate agenda items.
strengths: the metaphor revives contribution in teams bored of list formats
risks ahead and drag behind appear in the same picture
the island keeps the conversation anchored to the shared goal
visual format draws in people who stay quiet in verbal rounds
weaknesses: the metaphor obscures rather than helps for some participants
drifts into decoration unless the facilitator forces concrete items
no built-in prioritization of anchors or rocks
needs a drawing surface, which makes it awkward for audio-only teams
